_scope: One step per granted pilot host. The environment's egress policy decides at CONNECT,
which happens before any path is sent, so one request per host is sufficient to
establish reachability and is the smallest operation that answers the question.
No step downloads a dataset. Each fetches a documentation or single-record endpoint.
_url_provenance: documented = this exact URL appears in the NMRx chemical database map.
inferred   = composed from the map's description of the service; the exact path is
unconfirmed and must be checked against the official schema before use.
